propositions: A narrow named mutation operation (BindingStore.note_rich_emit) must own hash/counter/persistence behavior for production rich-text convergence while keeping all_bindings() shallow and public signatures unchanged.

The operation must produce identical hash, counter progression, and persisted bytes as the legacy mutation sequence (reached through shallow all_bindings()) when followed by a single unconditional save.

The operation must NOT perform a save of its own on any path (changed, unchanged, or missing binding), matching the production caller's behavior of mutating in place and relying on the pass's later save.
Missing bindings must remain nonfatal and distinguishable from success, returning None to match the legacy sequence behavior.
Production adapters and reconciler callers must not receive direct writable access to repository or lifecycle mutation methods through any facade boundary.
